articles.summary: Skukuza, South Africa - South African National Parks (SANParks) and Ampli Energy today announced a landmark private-sector renewable energy sponsorship agreement for South African conservation, starting with Kruger National Park (KNP) in its centenary year. The supply is equivalent to more than 25% of the park’s annual electricity consumption and will help advance KNP’s sustainability and decarbonisation goals.
articles.title: Renewable energy partnership to help decarbonise Kruger National Park in its centenary year.
